# Paths the build and every check under scripts/ need, in git's non-cone
# sparse-checkout syntax. Everything else under art/ and docs/evidence/ is
# authoring source and QA history (several GB) that neither the game nor its
# checks read. CI uses this list; a local partial clone can use it too:
#
#   git clone --filter=blob:none --sparse https://github.com/crrreatorrr/Sproto-Fighter
#   cd Sproto-Fighter
#   git show HEAD:.github/ci-checkout-paths.txt | git sparse-checkout set --no-cone --stdin
#
# If a check starts failing with ENOENT under art/ or docs/, add its path here.
/*

!/docs/evidence/
